decisions.reason: As a close-to-core component innovation that remained offered after other 2018 launches disappeared, finned tubes for air coolers likely have low carrying costs and preserve useful option value for the firm's broad installed-base and project business.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit the firm's engineering- and efficiency-focused core business, appear to have survived the initial market test, and are worth keeping because the downside of continuing is limited while their upside across multiple exchanger applications remains meaningful.
